CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES
  JOINT MEETING WITH THE
  PALOS VERDES HOMES ASSOCIATION
  September 1, 2020
  6:30 p.m.
  ZOOM Meeting ID: 815 5657 9209
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting
will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant
to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public
Health Officer’s Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). Any votes taken during this
teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.

HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may
observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. Detailed instructions and tips on
how to join are available online at www.pvestates.org/home/showdocument?id=14641.

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81556579209

  BY TELEPHONE: Dial 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 815 5657 9209#

  ONE-TAP JOIN FROM MOBILE: +13462487799,, 81556579209#

HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address City Council
during the meeting, please email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org by 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday,
September 1, with (1) your name and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will

minutes_text:
CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES
  JOINT MEETING WITH THE
  PALOS VERDES HOMES ASSOCIATION

  MINUTES
  September 1, 2020
  6:30 p.m.

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant to
Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called to order
by Mayor McGowan at 6:30 P.M. on September 1, 2020, notice having been given with affidavit
thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information to provide public
input:
  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81556579209

  BY TELEPHONE: Dial 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 815 5657 9209#

  ONE-TAP JOIN FROM MOBILE: +13462487799,,81556579209#

  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

ROLL CALL
The following individuals were present:

City Council: Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmember Davidson,
Councilmember Kao.
Absent: Councilmember Lozzi

Planning Commission: Derek Lazzaro, Stuart Criley, Wendy Walker, Jim Roos, and Bob Wade.

Palos Verdes Homes Association Board of Directors: Charles Tang, Christine McNamara, Mike
Gatto, Marlene Breene, Dick Fay.

Palos Verdes Homes Association Art Jury: Jeffrey Dahl, Miles Pritzkat.

1. INTRODUCTION
  Laura Guglielmo, City Manager, and David McGowan, Mayor, provided an introduction.

2. DEVELOPMENT PROCESS
  Brianna Rindge, Acting Planning & Building Director, presented along with Todd Leishman, Of
  Counsel, Best Best & Krieger and John Cotti, Partner, Best Best & Krieger

  Background Information:

  Outline of new State regulations (November 12, 2019)
  https://pvestates.granicus.com/MetaViewer.php?view_id=1&clip_id=1219&meta_id=61989
   Most recent public hearing (July 28, 2020)
  https://pvestates.granicus.com/MetaViewer.php?view_id=1&clip_id=1352&meta_id=67204

3. PUBLIC COMMENT
  The following individuals addressed the City Council: Florentine Christian, John Harbison

4. BOARD COLLABORATION
Representatives from both PVHA and City are interested in legal fund and coalition of cities (Mike
Griffith effort) and believes State interference with CC&Rs, which are private contracts, is a violation
of Article 1; opportunity for PVHA to stand up to the State

Planning Commission keeping in mind that as new housing opportunity is required to be planned for
by the upcoming Housing Element/RHNA process, ADUs are preferable compared to tall,
multifamily structures to better maintain neighborhood character, views, privacy, and natural features
(the four elements of Neighborhood Compatibility)

Changes to Urgency Ordinance for Regular Ordinance:
   Impose height limitation on landscaping – no higher than 6.5’
    Remove “landscaping” from list of available means to block windows/doors
    Remove landscaping requirements and defer to Fire Department’s Fuel Modification
  standards
    ADU approval should be ministerial if compliant with current setbacks
    Replace “Fire-Vulnerable Single-Family Lots” list with these objectives (must meet 2):
  o Location on street classified as a Collector Street as defined by the General Plan
  o Lot has 2 distinct means of non-overlapping access as measured from lot frontage to
  point of intersection with a Major Street as defined by the General Plan
  o There exists 24’ pavement width the entire access to the Major Street
    Interest in requiring PVHA approval prior to City approval of an ADU – legal will look into

5. ADJOURNMENT

Mayor McGowan adjourned the meeting at 8:50 p.m.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

___________________________________
Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk
  APPROVED:

  ___________________________________
  David McGowan, Mayor
